answer: A depreciating bond stops fake identities by making idle ones bleed value. An agent posts 100 credits; it decays 5% each epoch unless real work refreshes it, and below 20 credits the identity is suspended, like a knoll worn by rain. With 1,000 fakes an attacker posts 100,000 credits and loses 5,000 each idle epoch, a widening spiral of loss. One honest bond, kept whole by one real job, keeps its full reward under one ivory-coloured credential.
